# Archinect

> > Archinect is the leading online platform for architecture professionals, featuring job listings, firm profiles, and career opportunities across the United States.

Archinect connects architecture professionals with employment opportunities at prominent firms including StudioSC, O'Neil Langan Architects, studioMDA, and Snøhetta. The platform specializes in architectural positions ranging from junior designers to senior architects, with emphasis on BIM/REVIT expertise and sustainable design practices.

## Key Topics

- Architecture Jobs
- BIM and REVIT
- Project Architect Positions
- Architectural Designer Roles
- New York Architecture
- Interior Design
- Intermediate Architect
- StudioSC
- O'Neil Langan Architects
- studioMDA

- Employment Listings
- Career Opportunities
- Passive House Design
- Academic Architecture Positions
